overall.summary: OMCL shows a pattern of reduced disclosure specificity in the current filing period, particularly around supply chain risks and competitive vulnerability to tariffs — topics that are becoming more material industry-wide. The removal of the tariff-related competitive risk sentence (Flag 3) and the supply chain component quality risk factor (Flag 1) are the most concerning, as both deletions occur during a period of elevated tariff uncertainty that the company itself acknowledges in its MD&A.
